meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查网页和界面的显示效果，输出截图与结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常调整界面，想快速确认外观没有变坏。
copy.tagline_en: Inspect web, terminal, or paginated UI and get a screenshot-based verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you update UIs often and want to double-check appearances before sharing.

howto.what: 你改完界面后，Claude 会截取每个页面或终端画面，运行脚本比对差异与宽度，再派两个只读评审子代理并行检查，最后给出每页合格/不合格的结论。证据必须在最后一次改动之后重新生成。
howto.when: 当你改动任何 UI 之后，或问某个页面、组件、TUI 看起来对不对时触发；没有渲染界面的纯后端逻辑会跳过。

say.text: 帮我给刚做的登录页跑一次视觉 QA
say.note: 它会截屏比对并给出合格/不合格结论

say.text: 这个 TUI 在 120 列下会不会溢出？跑一下检查
say.note: 它会用 xterm.js 截图并跑宽度检查

say.text: 把这张设计稿和实际页面比对一下
say.note: 它会输出差异比例和热点区域

howto.what_en: After you build or change a UI, Claude captures every page or terminal surface, runs script-based diff and width checks, dispatches two read-only review subagents in parallel, and returns one pass/fail verdict per page based on fresh captures.
howto.when_en: Triggers after any UI build or change, or when you ask whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Skipped when there is no rendered surface, such as pure backend or library logic.

say_en.text: Run visual QA on the login page I just built
say_en.note: Captures, diffs, and returns a pass/fail verdict

say_en.text: Check whether this TUI overflows at 120 cols
say_en.note: Screenshots via xterm.js and runs the width check

say_en.text: Compare this mock against the actual page
say_en.note: Reports diff ratio and hotspot regions
